name: Standard Recipe Scaling & Calorie Calculation
description: Standard scaling from 4 to 8 servings with calorie estimation.
prompt: A recipe serves 4 people and uses 2 cups of flour. Scale it to serve 8 people. Each cup contains 455 calories. Calculate the calories for the scaled amount.

name: Missing Information & Multi-Turn Context Follow-Up
description: Initial prompt lacks target servings and calories; follow-up supplies target and calorie density.
turns: A recipe serves 4 people and uses 2 cups of flour.
Scale it to serve 8 people. Each cup has 455 calories.

name: Long-Term Memory Persistence & Recall
description: Recalls pre-saved user dietary preference/units across cold restart.
prompt: What are my stored culinary preferences and default target servings?

name: Grounded Knowledge Retrieval via Local RAG
description: Knowledge-based query requiring grounded document retrieval and citation.
prompt: How many calories are in 1 cup of all-purpose flour and how many grams does it weigh?

name: Defensive Validation & Consequential Oversight
description: Evaluates defensive rejection on zero original servings and extreme scaling approval gate.
prompt_invalid: A recipe serves 0 people and uses 2 cups of flour. Scale it to serve 8 people.
prompt_extreme: A recipe serves 4 people and uses 2 cups of flour. Scale it to serve 50 people. Each cup has 455 calories.
